success_evidence: Hash-pinned manifests and seeded paired schedules reject substituted inputs and incomplete live preregistrations.
Analysis retains failures, missing trials and usage, all attempt chains and explicit independent scoring evidence.

non_goals: No automatic adoption, broad routing, hook installation or retry coordinator.
No authority, capsule verifier, parent repository, credential or Autowork repair changes.
No live calls before operator resource selection and frozen lane-specific preconditions.
accepted_threats: Trusted local operator and evidence owners; hashes are integrity evidence only.
Calibration fixtures and small pilots cannot establish real-workload adoption.
Telemetry completeness, independent scoring and native state are asserted by their existing owners, not discovered by an offline analyzer.
